''Gestalt Therapy Verbatim'' is a short statement by psychotherapist Fritz Perls, a classic expression of Gestalt therapy as way of life model of which Dr. Perls was a founder.
{| class=wikitable
|-
| I do my thing and you do your thing.
| mi zukte lo me mi moi ije do zukte lo me do moi
|-
| I am not in this world to live up to your expectations,
| i mi na co'e bu'u lo dei munje fi'o se kanpe do
|-
| And you are not in this world to live up to mine.
| i si'a do na co'e bu'u lo dei munje fi'o se kanpe mi
|-
| You are you, and I am I,
| i do sevzi do ije mi sevzi mi
|-
| and if by chance we find each other, it's beautiful.
| ije fau da'i lo nu fi'o cunso mi jo'u do simxu lo ka penmi cu melbi
|-
| If not, it can't be helped.
| ije fau da'i lo nu na co'e cu ka'enai sidju
|-
| (Fritz Perls, "Gestalt Therapy Verbatim", 1969)
| (to la frits perls cu finti la'e lu lo verbatima po la gectalt poi mikce tadji toi)
|}
